text: The current helper tracks recovered, failed-to-recover, cleaned-up and no-cleanup counts separately, and compares only expectations that are non-null. Recovery and cleanup are different outcomes; zero is a valid expected count. Keep these counters distinct when adding error-path assertions. The source was read, but no indexer error was injected in this study. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Gloda indexing tests distinguish recovery from cleanup
